review_text: We had booked Dome Café, HSR Layout for our anniversary celebration, and it turned out to be a really good experience.  ✨ Ambience & Decoration The decoration was done beautifully and set the perfect vibe for a special evening. The domes themselves give a cozy and romantic feel, and the ambience inside is just stunning. Definitely Instagram-worthy!  🍰 Food & Drinks We were pleasantly surprised to receive a complimentary cake and mocktail which were good. For food, we ordered the Farmhouse Veg Burger, American Crispy Corn, and Peri Peri French Fries. The portions were generous, and by the end, our stomachs were completely full. The food was decent and good overall, matching our expectations for a casual celebration.  📸 Service The staff were polite and helpful, especially when it came to clicking our pictures and videos, which made our day more memorable.  ⚠️ Things to Improve The only drawback we faced was the ordering system. We had to get up and call the staff whenever we needed something. It would be a lot more convenient if each dome had a bell or calling system so that customers could press it whenever they require service. Also, lift access is only available till the 4th floor, and since the café is on the 5th floor, climbing a floor after the lift might be inconvenient for some.  💡 Final Word Overall, Dome Café is a lovely place with a beautiful ambience, good food, and friendly staff. Perfect for celebrations and special occasions, with just a small scope for improvement in service accessibility.

review_text: Visited The Dom Cafe recently and I’d say the experience was a mixed bag. Starting with the positives — the interiors inside the café are quite well done, with a cozy and modern vibe. The highlight is definitely the terrace area, where they’ve set up dome-shaped private seating cabins for small gatherings and functions. It’s a unique concept and adds a nice touch to the place, though I felt the terrace itself could’ve been designed better to match the interiors below.  Coming to the food — unfortunately, this is where things fell short for me. The menu was surprisingly very limited, which was unexpected. I ordered Fish Fingers, Margarita Pizza, French Fries, Butter Garlic Prawns, and a Cold Coffee. The Fish Fingers were a disappointment — they were over-fried and the fish inside had dried out completely. Ideally, fish fingers should be crispy outside and juicy inside, but this was far from it. The Margarita Pizza too lacked any distinct flavour and tasted rather bland, which was unfortunate for such a classic dish.  On the positive side, the French Fries, Butter Garlic Prawns, and Cold Coffee were good and lived up to expectations.  Service-wise, the staff were genuinely friendly and polite. However, there was one odd incident where someone started sweeping the floor with a broom right next to our table while we were eating. It was a bit off-putting and could have easily been avoided. It’s little things like this that affect the overall dining experience.  To sum it up — The Dom Cafe has great potential with its unique dome-style terrace seating and pleasant interiors, but they really need to improve the food quality and fine-tune their service practices. Would I visit again? Maybe, but only if they expand their menu and work on the kitchen standard.
